definition: High-water RSS includes waited-for child process high-water values; it is not the simultaneous sum of the process tree.

validation.parent: python3 launching a Python child that allocates a 64 MiB bytearray
validation.interpretation: Child allocation is included, and sequential child peaks are not added together.

correction: The original run/resources.json scope string called this worker-lifetime RSS. The values are unchanged; the report uses the corrected OS peak-RSS scope. Killed worker groups may lack OS samples, so their reported peak is a lower bound.
